section_summary: This section records Japanese merchant-vessel movements in Peru, Chile, Mexico, Japan, Thailand, and French Indochina during September and October 1941. It also includes a report on the end of Japanese shipping service to New Zealand, a memorandum about oil bunkering contacts, and a naval intelligence report on the NOTO MARU. Most movement reports are followed by State Department copies prepared for the Navy.

people.name: Patchin
people.role: Proposed contact concerning the Arrow Oil Company

people.name: Syunsi Sato
people.role: Reported captain of a Japanese vessel and passenger on the NOTO MARU

people.name: Count Aisinari di San Marzano
people.role: Italian passenger on the NOTO MARU

people.name: J. P. Conover, Jr.
people.role: Commander, U.S. Navy (retired), and naval attaché

people.name: Frothingham
people.role: Navy commander telephoned about the NOTO MARU

subfiles.title: SAKITO MARU towing ARIMA MARU
subfiles.about: The SAKITO MARU left Callao for Yokohama towing the ARIMA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Reports the October 9 departure.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission of SAKITO MARU report
subfiles.about: Relays the Callao departure and tow.
subfiles.summary: Records the SAKITO MARU towing the ARIMA MARU toward Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Suspension of service of Japanese vessels to New Zealand
subfiles.from: Raymond E. Cox, American Consul General, Wellington
subfiles.about: Japanese shipping service to New Zealand ceased after the YAMAGIKU MARU sailed.
subfiles.summary: Cox reports that no further Japanese calls were scheduled after the YAMAGIKU MARU left Lyttelton. He describes restrictions on its sheep, seed, and wool cargo and notes that eight Japanese businessmen sailed as passengers.

subfiles.title: Transmittal of Wellington despatch to Maritime Commission
subfiles.about: Forwards Cox’s despatch on suspended Japanese shipping service.
subfiles.summary: Transmits a copy of Wellington despatch no. 110.

subfiles.title: NOTO MARU cargo at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: The NOTO MARU carried mineral ores from Antofagasta toward Tocopilla.
subfiles.summary: Reports its arrival from Huasco, departure for Tocopilla, and wolfram, copper, and antimony cargo.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Antofagasta report
subfiles.about: Relays the NOTO MARU’s movements and ore cargo.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Adams’s report and records Navy transmission.

subfiles.title: Arrow Oil Company bunkering facilities
subfiles.about: Suggests contacting the Arrow Oil Company about a meeting on west coast bunkering.
subfiles.summary: Identifies Arrow Oil as a Grace subsidiary and proposes contacting Patchin.

subfiles.title: NOTO MARU at Manzanillo, first report copy
subfiles.about: Reports the NOTO MARU’s Manzanillo call, cargo, passengers, and sudden departure.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Yokohama on September 13, discharged goods including mail, and left for Callao without refueling. Two passengers disembarked.

subfiles.title: NOTO MARU at Manzanillo, second report copy
subfiles.about: Duplicates the report on the NOTO MARU’s Manzanillo call.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its cargo, passenger, and departure details.

subfiles.title: GYOKO departure from Bangkok
subfiles.about: Reports the Japanese GYOKO’s departure on October 13.
subfiles.summary: A brief vessel departure notice.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of GYOKO departure
subfiles.about: Relays the GYOKO departure report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Peck’s departure notice.

subfiles.title: Japanese vessel from Manzanillo at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese ship arriving at Callao from Manzanillo and sailing for Iquique.
subfiles.summary: Its name is unclear in the OCR, appearing as “AZUA MRU.”

subfiles.title: Navy transmission of Callao arrival and departure
subfiles.about: Relays the Callao arrival and departure of the ship reported on page 253.
subfiles.summary: The OCR gives the ship’s name as “AZULHA LARU” and “AZULIA HARU.”

subfiles.title: DELHI arrival at Bangkok
subfiles.about: Reports the DELHI arriving from Haiphong.
subfiles.summary: States that no other vessel-movement information changed.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of DELHI arrival
subfiles.about: Relays the DELHI’s arrival from Haiphong.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Peck’s arrival notice.

subfiles.title: Bangkok arrivals and HUZIMI correction
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese arrivals and retracts an earlier HUZIMI arrival.
subfiles.summary: NITI arrived from Keelung and AKIBASAN from Saigon; the September 22 HUZIMI report was erroneous.

subfiles.title: Navy teletype of Bangkok arrivals
subfiles.about: Relays Peck’s arrivals and HUZIMI correction.
subfiles.summary: Lists NITI and AKIBASAN and withdraws the HUZIMI arrival.

subfiles.title: Second Navy form for Bangkok arrivals
subfiles.about: Records the same NITI and AKIBASAN arrivals.
subfiles.summary: Also notes the earlier HUZIMI arrival report.

subfiles.title: TATUTA sailing from Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports the requisitioned TATUTA sailing for Honolulu and San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: The ship left October 15 with 602 passengers and no cargo.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of TATUTA sailing
subfiles.about: Relays the TATUTA’s requisition and passenger sailing.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linnell’s Yokohama report.

subfiles.title: TIKYO MARU arrival at Haiphong
subfiles.about: Reports the TIKYO MARU’s Haiphong arrival and no other local movements.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived October 12; Saigon had no arrivals and neither port reported departures.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Haiphong arrival
subfiles.about: Relays the TIKYO MARU’s Haiphong arrival.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Browne’s report of no other arrivals or departures.

subfiles.title: Expected NARUTO MARU arrival at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: The NARUTO MARU was expected from Yokohama around October 24.
subfiles.summary: Notes that the embassy was informed.

subfiles.title: Bangkok arrival and departure
subfiles.about: Reports NAN arriving from Hainan and TETUWA departing for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Both movements occurred October 17.

subfiles.title: Navy form for Bangkok movements
subfiles.about: Relays the October 17 Bangkok arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Records the arrival from Hainan and departure for Japan.

subfiles.title: HIKAWA sailing from Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports the requisitioned HIKAWA sailing for Seattle via Vancouver.
subfiles.summary: It left October 20 with 239 passengers and no cargo.

subfiles.title: Navy form for HIKAWA sailing
subfiles.about: Relays the HIKAWA’s requisition and sailing.
subfiles.summary: Records its Seattle destination via Vancouver and its passenger load.

subfiles.title: TAIYO sailing for Honolulu
subfiles.about: Reports the requisitioned TAIYO sailing for Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: It left October 22 with 343 passengers and no cargo.

subfiles.title: Navy form for TAIYO sailing
subfiles.about: Relays the TAIYO’s passenger sailing and requisition.
subfiles.summary: Records 343 passengers, no cargo, and Honolulu as destination.

subfiles.title: Japanese MARU movements in French Indochina
subfiles.about: Lists Japanese ship arrivals and departures at Haiphong, Hongay, and Saigon.
subfiles.summary: Reports movements of AKAGISAN, KANZYO, SUGIYAMA, TIUGOZ, and TOLOZ and corrects an earlier TIYU identification.

subfiles.title: Navy form for French Indochina movements
subfiles.about: Relays Browne’s vessel movements and name correction.
subfiles.summary: Tabulates the Haiphong, Hongay, and Saigon movements and corrects TIYU to TIUGOZ.
